questions.q: The main purpose of a storyboard is to…
options: Plan the shots visually before production

questions.q: Which order is correct?
A storyboard panel usually contains…
options: A drawing, action notes, dialogue, camera direction and duration

questions.q: An establishing shot…
options: Shows a character's emotion in detail
Shows where the scene takes place

questions.q: A close-up is mainly used to show…
An extreme close-up shows…
options: A small detail, such as the eyes

questions.q: A medium shot frames a character…
options: From head to toe with surroundings

questions.q: A wide (long) shot shows…
options: The whole body together with its surroundings

questions.q: A high-angle shot makes the subject look…
A low-angle shot makes the subject look…
A bird's-eye shot is filmed…
A Dutch angle (tilted camera) usually creates…
A pan is when the camera…
options: Rotates horizontally from a fixed position

questions.q: A tilt is when the camera…
options: Rotates vertically from a fixed position

questions.q: A dolly (tracking) shot is when the camera…
options: Physically moves toward, away from or alongside the subject

questions.q: A zoom is when…
options: The camera moves on a crane
The actor walks to the camera
The lens changes focal length while the camera stays in place

questions.q: The 180-degree rule exists to…

options: Characters seem to switch sides, confusing the viewer

questions.q: Shot / reverse shot is mainly used for…

options: From behind one character's shoulder, looking at the other

questions.q: The rule of thirds means…
options: Placing key elements along the lines or intersections that divide the frame into thirds

questions.q: Leading lines in a composition…
options: Are the edges of the frame
Guide the viewer's eye toward the subject

options: A character looking to what they are looking at

questions.q: A match cut links two shots through…
options: A similar shape, movement or composition

questions.q: A straight cut is…
options: An instant change from one shot to the next

questions.q: A dissolve…
options: Gradually blends one image into the next, often to show time passing

questions.q: A fade to black usually…

options: A storyboard timed with sound to test pacing

options: Show the user's situation and need as a sequence of panels
